hints.content: Kenny has scored $\blue{13}$ points and Michael has scored an unknown number of points, which we're calling $\green{p}$.  All together, they have scored $\pink{27}$ points.

We can represent Kenny and Michael's points as a sum:

 $\blue{13} + \green{p}$

We know that together they have scored $\pink{27}$ points.

The following equation matches this situation:

 >$\blue{13} + \green{p} = \pink{27}$
